# Zotero 10.0.2 API contract fixtures

Unmodified files extracted from the local Zotero 10.0.2 `app/omni.ja`, 2026-09-15:

- `chrome/content/zotero/xpcom/annotations.js`
- `chrome/content/zotero/xpcom/pluginAPI/pluginAPIBase.mjs`
- `chrome/content/zotero/xpcom/pluginAPI/itemPaneManager.js`

Copyright and AGPL-3.0-or-later notices remain in each source file. These are test-only fixtures and are not shipped in the XPI. The tests execute Zotero's real validation and serialization logic with an isolated data-layer substitute; they are not desktop integration tests.
